spiritgiven.comments: Communication was good at the beginning of the game but i got worse at the end expecially with the coaches and couple of players wich also weren’t really calm while talking to us, but still a nice and intense match!
It was a really intense match but the spirit still was amazing, the girls were always lovely, kind and complimented to us a lot. Also comunication was extrimelly good and always respectfull!
Lovely match, always respetcfull and kind!
Thank you america for this challenging match! We loved the energy, attitude and especially the intensity
Thank you for the challenging match! It was hard to communicate becouse of the language barriers but we still maneged to tolk to eachother!
Loved the energy and that you gave everything having an amazing come back! Thank you for the tough game!

spiritreceived.comments: On double teaming and fast counts the stall was never dropped. Despite numerous calls for fouls and body contact, we felt this did not improve throughout the game.There were multiple examples of bad attitude. There were many spikes of the disc after scoring even after speaking to your coaches. We were made to wait for captains as you were 'finishing a drill' limiting our warm up. One player made a rude gesture when making a call which got a rise out of your sideline and coaches.

We thank you for improving the level of contact after communicating our discomfort however it did take multiple conversations for this to effectively occur. 
Communication was very strong both on field and off field, thank you for your lovely energy, positive attitude and great game
Thanks for this fun game and for implementing our feedback from the pre circle :))

The game was very intense and competitive, but the physicality was led to a few plays considered dangerous by the game advisors. Slightly higher physicality was acceptable for both teams, but we want to ensure the game stays safe. However, even with all the stoppages and language barriers there was calm and patient communication between the teams.
It was the toughest game ever and everyone did really hard on playing. I think it will be really appreciated if you guys care about the disc space the next game! Good luck!
Stall count came it at the wrong count after fouls, lots of contract, sideline (coaches) had strong reactions to calls. But the communication was good!
Very fun tight game but a lot of contact on the mark and on the cutters.
Lots of contact and we told them at halftime, but it was a lot better after. The communication was good and there was good spirit on the sideline.
Intense game, some calls felt like they benefit Italy and communication could have been quicker. Great game overall!
